metadata.title: ALCOSAN Clean Water Plan, Section 4: Hydrologic and Hydraulic Characterization
metadata.model_scenario: Existing-condition typical-year hydrologic and hydraulic model simulation
metadata.model_period: A refined calendar-year 2003 rainfall dataset calibrated to produce annual statistics equivalent to a 60-year historical precipitation record; not observed overflow data from a single calendar year.
metadata.model_geography: Individual CSO outfall within the named ALCOSAN planning basin; not parcel or pipe-segment geography.
limitations: Model outputs are historical typical-year scenario estimates, not measured present-day overflow observations.
The representative 2003 rainfall dataset was refined to represent long-term statistics; reported values are not actual 2003 meter readings.
Outfall values do not establish parcel-specific overflow exposure, sewer service, pipe condition, or available capacity.
PWSA combined-sewershed IDs provide geography only where a source identifier matches an outfall ID under the documented exact-match rule.
